subject: DI03005061

body.en:
Definition and principle

A material balance is an accounting statement based on conservation of mass within a selected system boundary. A basis is a declared amount of material or period of operation to which every quantity refers. A component balance follows a named species; an overall balance follows total mass.

Balance method and important conditions

First draw and label every inlet/outlet and select a convenient basis, for example100 kg feed or1hour. Convert all compositions to a common mass or molar basis and use molecular weights when changing basis. At steady state accumulation is zero. With no reaction, generation and consumption are zero. With mass in kg and molecular weight in kg/kmol, the amount is in kmol. Count independent unknowns and equations before solving; an overall balance is not independent of the sum of all component mass balances. In the general balance, A=accumulation, I/O=inflow/outflow, G/C=generation/consumption. Check both total and each conserved component. Do not add volumes unless volume additivity is explicitly justified.

Equations / symbols
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા તથા સિદ્ધાંત

પસંદ કરેલી system boundary માં mass conservation પ્રમાણે કરાતો હિસાબ Material Balance છે. બધી quantities માટે પસંદ કરેલું material amount અથવા operating time Basis છે. Component balance માં ચોક્કસ species અને overall balance માં કુલ mass ગણાય છે.

Balance Method તથા જરૂરી Conditions

પ્રથમ દરેક inlet/outlet label કરીને diagram દોરો અને 100 kg feed અથવા 1hour જેવી basis લો. Compositions ને એકસરખી mass અથવા molar basis પર લાવો; basis બદલતાં molecular weights વાપરો. Steady state માં accumulation zero અને reaction વગર generation/consumption zero છે. Mass kg માં તથા MW kg/kmol માં હોય તો amount kmol માં મળે છે. Unknowns સામે independent equations ગણો. બધા component mass balances ના sum ઉપરાંત overall balance ને વધારાનું independent equation ન ગણો. General balance માં A=accumulation, I/O=inflow/outflow તથા G/C=generation/consumption છે. Total તથા દરેક conserved component check કરો. Volume additivity explicitly આપેલી ન હોય તો volumes સીધાં ન ઉમેરો.

સમીકરણો / સંકેતો

body.en:
Definition and principle

Distillation separates components by differences in volatility. Feed F forms a distillate D enriched in the more volatile component and a residue/bottoms B depleted in it. Composition symbols must refer to the same named component and the same mass/mole basis.

Balance method and important conditions

For a specified steady nonreacting splitter with two outlet compositions, use the overall and one component balance. These are material balances, not a prediction of equilibrium stages or reflux requirements. A physically possible split requires the feed composition to lie between the two product compositions. A negative product amount signals inconsistent data or a mistaken basis.

Equations / symbols
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા તથા સિદ્ધાંત

Volatility ના તફાવતથી separation કરતી operation Distillation છે. Feed F માંથી વધુ volatile component થી enriched distillate D અને depleted bottoms B મળે છે. Composition ના બધા symbols એક જ component તથા mass/mole basis માટે હોવા જોઈએ.

Balance Method તથા જરૂરી Conditions

બે outlet compositions આપેલા steady nonreacting system માં overall તથા એક component balance લો. આ material balance છે; equilibrium stages અથવા reflux ની આગાહી નથી. Physical split માટે feed composition બંને product compositions વચ્ચે હોવી જોઈએ. Negative product quantity મળે તો data અથવા basis તપાસો.

સમીકરણો / સંકેતો

body.en:
Definition and principle

Absorption transfers a soluble gas component into a liquid absorbent. A gas carrier and a liquid solvent provide convenient conserved streams when they neither dissolve appreciably nor evaporate. Y is solute amount per solute-free gas carrier; X is solute amount per solute-free solvent, not a mole fraction.

Balance method and important conditions

Choose kmol or kg consistently. Track the nonabsorbed carrier to find outlet total gas after solute removal. Specify whether percent removal refers to inlet solute amount or a concentration change; these are not identical. The solute-free relation assumes constant carrier and solvent amounts. If solvent evaporates or carrier dissolves, include those extra component balances.

Equations / symbols
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા તથા સિદ્ધાંત

Soluble gas component ને liquid absorbent માં transfer કરતી operation Absorption છે. Carrier gas appreciably dissolve અને solvent evaporate ન થાય ત્યારે બંને conserved streams છે. Y એટલે solute-free gas carrier દીઠ solute અને X એટલે solute-free solvent દીઠ solute; આ mole fractions નથી.

Balance Method તથા જરૂરી Conditions

એકસરખી kmol અથવા kg basis લો. Solute દૂર થયા પછી outlet total gas મેળવવા nonabsorbed carrier balance કરો. Percent removal inlet solute amount માટે છે કે concentration change માટે, તે સ્પષ્ટ કરો; બંને એક નથી. Solute-free equation માટે carrier તથા solvent amounts constant જોઈએ. Solvent evaporation અથવા carrier dissolution હોય તો વધારાના component balances લો.

title.gu: Drying—Wet Basis,Dry Basis તથા Humid Air

h.en: Drying—wet basis,dry basis and humid air
h.gu: Drying—Wet Basis,Dry Basis તથા Humid Air

body.en:
Definition and principle

Drying removes volatile moisture from a wet solid. Dry solid is conserved when entrainment and solid loss are negligible. Wet-basis moisture is water divided by total wet material. Dry-basis moisture is water divided by bone-dry solid. Humidity H is kg water vapour per kg dry air.

Balance method and important conditions

Convert every moisture datum before balancing. First balance the dry solid, then water. Use dry-air flow—not total humid-air flow—in an air-humidity balance. The simple calculation neglects leaks, condensation and entrainment. Water removed is not generally the difference between two moisture percentages multiplied by feed mass.

Equations / symbols
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા તથા સિદ્ધાંત

Wet solid માંથી volatile moisture દૂર કરતી operation Drying છે. Entrainment તથા solid loss negligible હોય ત્યારે dry solid conserved છે. Wet-basis moisture માં water ને total wet material થી અને dry-basis માં water ને bone-dry solid થી ભાગો. Humidity H એટલે dry air દીઠ water vapour, kg/kg dry air.

Balance Method તથા જરૂરી Conditions

Balance પહેલાં દરેક moisture datum convert કરો. પ્રથમ dry solid અને પછી water balance લો. Air humidity balance માં total humid air નહીં, ફક્ત dry-air flow લો. Simple calculation માં leaks, condensation તથા entrainment negligible છે. Water removed એટલે બે moisture percentages નો તફાવત ×feed mass સામાન્ય રીતે નથી.

body.en:
Definition and principle

Liquid-liquid extraction transfers a solute between liquid phases using a selective solvent. The solvent-rich outlet is extract; the original-carrier-rich outlet is raffinate. These names describe phase roles, not pure components.

Balance method and important conditions

Use total and component balances with explicitly supplied equilibrium/partition data. If carriers are treated as mutually insoluble, state that approximation. A distribution coefficient must declare its concentration definition: solute per solvent, solute mass fraction and molarity are different bases. Do not substitute a mass-fraction ratio into a solute-free ratio equation. If phase solubilities matter, the full ternary compositions are needed.

Equations / symbols
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા તથા સિદ્ધાંત

Selective solvent વડે બે liquid phases વચ્ચે solute transfer કરતી operation Liquid-liquid Extraction છે. Solvent-rich outlet Extract અને original-carrier-rich outlet Raffinate છે. આ phase roles છે, pure components ના નામ નથી.

Balance Method તથા જરૂરી Conditions

આપેલા equilibrium/partition data સાથે total તથા component balances લો. Carriers mutually insoluble માન્યા હોય તો assumption લખો. Distribution coefficient માં concentration basis સ્પષ્ટ કરો: solute per solvent, mass fraction તથા molarity જુદા છે. Mass-fraction ratio ને solute-free ratio equation માં સીધું ન મૂકો. Phase solubilities મહત્વની હોય તો સંપૂર્ણ ternary compositions જોઈએ.

body.en:
Definition and principle

Leaching extracts a soluble constituent from an insoluble solid using a liquid solvent. The overflow is a solute-bearing solution; the underflow contains inert solid plus solution retained by it. The retained liquor is not pure solvent unless explicitly specified.

Balance method and important conditions

Track insoluble solid separately. Assuming complete dissolution and equal liquor composition throughout a single ideal contact, find solution concentration from all dissolved solute and solvent, then apply the specified retained solution per kg inert solid. Solute recovered excludes solute remaining in the retained liquor. If incomplete dissolution is specified, undissolved solute requires its own accounting.

Equations / symbols
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા તથા સિદ્ધાંત

Liquid solvent વડે insoluble solid માંથી soluble constituent કાઢતી operation Leaching છે. Overflow solute-bearing solution છે; underflow માં inert solid સાથે retained solution હોય છે. Retained liquor ને આપમેળે pure solvent ન માનો.

Balance Method તથા જરૂરી Conditions

Insoluble solid અલગ balance કરો. Single ideal contact માં complete dissolution તથા uniform liquor composition માની total dissolved solute/solvent પરથી concentration શોધો. પછી kg inert solid દીઠ retained solution ની condition લાગુ કરો. Retained liquor નો solute recovered માં ન ગણો. Incomplete dissolution હોય તો undissolved solute અલગ ગણવો પડે.

body.en:
Definition and principle

Evaporation concentrates a solution by removing volatile solvent as vapour. For a nonvolatile solute with no entrainment, all inlet solute remains in the concentrate. A material balance alone does not determine the steam requirement.

Balance method and important conditions

Find concentrate from solute conservation, then evaporated solvent by the overall balance. For multiple effects, the overall solute balance still applies, but individual vapour rates require extra data. Energy balances need feed/boiling temperatures, latent heats, heat losses and appropriate steam conditions.

Equations / symbols
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા તથા સિદ્ધાંત

Solvent ને vapour રૂપે દૂર કરીને solution concentrate કરતી operation Evaporation છે. Nonvolatile solute તથા negligible entrainment માટે feed નો બધો solute concentrate માં રહે છે. Material balance પરથી એકલું steam requirement ન મળે.

Balance Method તથા જરૂરી Conditions

Solute conservation પરથી concentrate અને પછી overall balance પરથી evaporated solvent શોધો. Multiple effects માટે overall solute balance લાગુ પડે છે, પણ દરેક effect ના vapour rates માટે વધુ data જોઈએ. Energy balance માટે feed/boiling temperatures, latent heats, losses તથા steam conditions જોઈએ.

body.en:
Definition and principle

Mixing combines streams to obtain a specified product composition. In a nonreacting mass-based blend, total mass and each component mass are conserved. The product concentration is a weighted average on the declared basis.

Balance method and important conditions

Use kg with mass fractions or kmol with mole fractions. A volume percentage is not a mass percentage; densities and a suitable volume model are needed to switch between them. Two-stream target composition must lie between the feed compositions. If temperature changes, an additional energy balance may be needed; material balance does not imply isothermal mixing.

Equations / symbols
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા તથા સિદ્ધાંત

Streams ભેગી કરીને specified composition મેળવવાની operation Mixing છે. Nonreacting mass-based blend માં total તથા દરેક component mass conserved છે. Product concentration declared basis પર weighted average છે.

Balance Method તથા જરૂરી Conditions

kg સાથે mass fractions અથવા kmol સાથે mole fractions લો. Volume percentage એ mass percentage નથી; conversion માટે densities તથા યોગ્ય volume model જોઈએ. Two-stream target બંને inlet compositions વચ્ચે હોવો જોઈએ. Temperature બદલાય તો energy balance પણ જોઈએ; material balance નો અર્થ isothermal mixing નથી.

body.en:
Definition and principle

Crystallization separates solid crystals from a solution by cooling, evaporation or both. Mother liquor is the remaining liquid solution. Solubility stated as kg solute per100 kg water must be converted to a solution mass fraction before use in a solution balance.

Balance method and important conditions

For pure anhydrous crystals, the crystal solute fraction is1. For a hydrate, use the anhydrous-salt molecular mass divided by the hydrate molecular mass; the remainder is crystal water. Balance both salt and water, including evaporated water and any retained mother liquor if specified. Do not count water of crystallization as free mother-liquor water.

Equations / symbols
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા તથા સિદ્ધાંત

Cooling, evaporation અથવા બંનેથી solution માંથી solid crystals અલગ કરવાની operation Crystallization છે. બાકી liquid solution Mother Liquor છે. Solubility kg solute per100 kg water માં હોય તો solution balance પહેલાં mass fraction માં convert કરો.

Balance Method તથા જરૂરી Conditions

Pure anhydrous crystals માટે crystal solute fraction 1 છે. Hydrate માટે anhydrous salt MW ને hydrate MW થી ભાગો; બાકી crystal water છે. Evaporated water અને specified retained liquor સહિત salt તથા water balance લો. Water of crystallization ને free mother-liquor water માં ન ગણો.

q.en: State the definition/principle of Material balance—basis,boundary and closure.

a.en: A material balance is an accounting statement based on conservation of mass within a selected system boundary. A basis is a declared amount of material or period of operation to which every quantity refers. A component balance follows a named species; an overall balance follows total mass. First draw and label every inlet/outlet and select a convenient basis, for example100 kg feed or1hour. Convert all compositions to a common mass or molar basis and use molecular weights when changing basis. At steady state accumulation is zero. With no reaction, generation and consumption are zero. With mass in kg and molecular weight in kg/kmol, the amount is in kmol. Count independent unknowns and equations before solving; an overall balance is not independent of the sum of all component mass balances. In the general balance, A=accumulation, I/O=inflow/outflow, G/C=generation/consumption. Check both total and each conserved component. Do not add volumes unless volume additivity is explicitly justified.
a.gu: પસંદ કરેલી system boundary માં mass conservation પ્રમાણે કરાતો હિસાબ Material Balance છે. બધી quantities માટે પસંદ કરેલું material amount અથવા operating time Basis છે. Component balance માં ચોક્કસ species અને overall balance માં કુલ mass ગણાય છે. પ્રથમ દરેક inlet/outlet label કરીને diagram દોરો અને 100 kg feed અથવા 1hour જેવી basis લો. Compositions ને એકસરખી mass અથવા molar basis પર લાવો; basis બદલતાં molecular weights વાપરો. Steady state માં accumulation zero અને reaction વગર generation/consumption zero છે. Mass kg માં તથા MW kg/kmol માં હોય તો amount kmol માં મળે છે. Unknowns સામે independent equations ગણો. બધા component mass balances ના sum ઉપરાંત overall balance ને વધારાનું independent equation ન ગણો. General balance માં A=accumulation, I/O=inflow/outflow તથા G/C=generation/consumption છે. Total તથા દરેક conserved component check કરો. Volume additivity explicitly આપેલી ન હોય તો volumes સીધાં ન ઉમેરો.

q.en: State the definition/principle of Distillation—two-product component balances.
q.gu: Distillation—બે Products ના Component Balances ની વ્યાખ્યા/સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: Distillation separates components by differences in volatility. Feed F forms a distillate D enriched in the more volatile component and a residue/bottoms B depleted in it. Composition symbols must refer to the same named component and the same mass/mole basis. For a specified steady nonreacting splitter with two outlet compositions, use the overall and one component balance. These are material balances, not a prediction of equilibrium stages or reflux requirements. A physically possible split requires the feed composition to lie between the two product compositions. A negative product amount signals inconsistent data or a mistaken basis.
a.gu: Volatility ના તફાવતથી separation કરતી operation Distillation છે. Feed F માંથી વધુ volatile component થી enriched distillate D અને depleted bottoms B મળે છે. Composition ના બધા symbols એક જ component તથા mass/mole basis માટે હોવા જોઈએ. બે outlet compositions આપેલા steady nonreacting system માં overall તથા એક component balance લો. આ material balance છે; equilibrium stages અથવા reflux ની આગાહી નથી. Physical split માટે feed composition બંને product compositions વચ્ચે હોવી જોઈએ. Negative product quantity મળે તો data અથવા basis તપાસો.

q.en: State the definition/principle of Absorption—solute-free carrier balances.
q.gu: Absorption—Solute-free Carrier Balances ની વ્યાખ્યા/સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: Absorption transfers a soluble gas component into a liquid absorbent. A gas carrier and a liquid solvent provide convenient conserved streams when they neither dissolve appreciably nor evaporate. Y is solute amount per solute-free gas carrier; X is solute amount per solute-free solvent, not a mole fraction. Choose kmol or kg consistently. Track the nonabsorbed carrier to find outlet total gas after solute removal. Specify whether percent removal refers to inlet solute amount or a concentration change; these are not identical. The solute-free relation assumes constant carrier and solvent amounts. If solvent evaporates or carrier dissolves, include those extra component balances.
a.gu: Soluble gas component ને liquid absorbent માં transfer કરતી operation Absorption છે. Carrier gas appreciably dissolve અને solvent evaporate ન થાય ત્યારે બંને conserved streams છે. Y એટલે solute-free gas carrier દીઠ solute અને X એટલે solute-free solvent દીઠ solute; આ mole fractions નથી. એકસરખી kmol અથવા kg basis લો. Solute દૂર થયા પછી outlet total gas મેળવવા nonabsorbed carrier balance કરો. Percent removal inlet solute amount માટે છે કે concentration change માટે, તે સ્પષ્ટ કરો; બંને એક નથી. Solute-free equation માટે carrier તથા solvent amounts constant જોઈએ. Solvent evaporation અથવા carrier dissolution હોય તો વધારાના component balances લો.

q.en: State the definition/principle of Drying—wet basis,dry basis and humid air.
q.gu: Drying—Wet Basis,Dry Basis તથા Humid Air ની વ્યાખ્યા/સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: Drying removes volatile moisture from a wet solid. Dry solid is conserved when entrainment and solid loss are negligible. Wet-basis moisture is water divided by total wet material. Dry-basis moisture is water divided by bone-dry solid. Humidity H is kg water vapour per kg dry air. Convert every moisture datum before balancing. First balance the dry solid, then water. Use dry-air flow—not total humid-air flow—in an air-humidity balance. The simple calculation neglects leaks, condensation and entrainment. Water removed is not generally the difference between two moisture percentages multiplied by feed mass.
a.gu: Wet solid માંથી volatile moisture દૂર કરતી operation Drying છે. Entrainment તથા solid loss negligible હોય ત્યારે dry solid conserved છે. Wet-basis moisture માં water ને total wet material થી અને dry-basis માં water ને bone-dry solid થી ભાગો. Humidity H એટલે dry air દીઠ water vapour, kg/kg dry air. Balance પહેલાં દરેક moisture datum convert કરો. પ્રથમ dry solid અને પછી water balance લો. Air humidity balance માં total humid air નહીં, ફક્ત dry-air flow લો. Simple calculation માં leaks, condensation તથા entrainment negligible છે. Water removed એટલે બે moisture percentages નો તફાવત ×feed mass સામાન્ય રીતે નથી.

q.en: State the definition/principle of Liquid extraction—extract and raffinate.
q.gu: Liquid Extraction—Extract તથા Raffinate ની વ્યાખ્યા/સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: Liquid-liquid extraction transfers a solute between liquid phases using a selective solvent. The solvent-rich outlet is extract; the original-carrier-rich outlet is raffinate. These names describe phase roles, not pure components. Use total and component balances with explicitly supplied equilibrium/partition data. If carriers are treated as mutually insoluble, state that approximation. A distribution coefficient must declare its concentration definition: solute per solvent, solute mass fraction and molarity are different bases. Do not substitute a mass-fraction ratio into a solute-free ratio equation. If phase solubilities matter, the full ternary compositions are needed.
a.gu: Selective solvent વડે બે liquid phases વચ્ચે solute transfer કરતી operation Liquid-liquid Extraction છે. Solvent-rich outlet Extract અને original-carrier-rich outlet Raffinate છે. આ phase roles છે, pure components ના નામ નથી. આપેલા equilibrium/partition data સાથે total તથા component balances લો. Carriers mutually insoluble માન્યા હોય તો assumption લખો. Distribution coefficient માં concentration basis સ્પષ્ટ કરો: solute per solvent, mass fraction તથા molarity જુદા છે. Mass-fraction ratio ને solute-free ratio equation માં સીધું ન મૂકો. Phase solubilities મહત્વની હોય તો સંપૂર્ણ ternary compositions જોઈએ.

q.en: State the definition/principle of Leaching—solute recovery and retained solution.
q.gu: Leaching—Solute Recovery તથા Retained Solution ની વ્યાખ્યા/સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: Leaching extracts a soluble constituent from an insoluble solid using a liquid solvent. The overflow is a solute-bearing solution; the underflow contains inert solid plus solution retained by it. The retained liquor is not pure solvent unless explicitly specified. Track insoluble solid separately. Assuming complete dissolution and equal liquor composition throughout a single ideal contact, find solution concentration from all dissolved solute and solvent, then apply the specified retained solution per kg inert solid. Solute recovered excludes solute remaining in the retained liquor. If incomplete dissolution is specified, undissolved solute requires its own accounting.
a.gu: Liquid solvent વડે insoluble solid માંથી soluble constituent કાઢતી operation Leaching છે. Overflow solute-bearing solution છે; underflow માં inert solid સાથે retained solution હોય છે. Retained liquor ને આપમેળે pure solvent ન માનો. Insoluble solid અલગ balance કરો. Single ideal contact માં complete dissolution તથા uniform liquor composition માની total dissolved solute/solvent પરથી concentration શોધો. પછી kg inert solid દીઠ retained solution ની condition લાગુ કરો. Retained liquor નો solute recovered માં ન ગણો. Incomplete dissolution હોય તો undissolved solute અલગ ગણવો પડે.

q.en: State the definition/principle of Evaporation—nonvolatile solute balance.
q.gu: Evaporation—Nonvolatile Solute Balance ની વ્યાખ્યા/સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: Evaporation concentrates a solution by removing volatile solvent as vapour. For a nonvolatile solute with no entrainment, all inlet solute remains in the concentrate. A material balance alone does not determine the steam requirement. Find concentrate from solute conservation, then evaporated solvent by the overall balance. For multiple effects, the overall solute balance still applies, but individual vapour rates require extra data. Energy balances need feed/boiling temperatures, latent heats, heat losses and appropriate steam conditions.
a.gu: Solvent ને vapour રૂપે દૂર કરીને solution concentrate કરતી operation Evaporation છે. Nonvolatile solute તથા negligible entrainment માટે feed નો બધો solute concentrate માં રહે છે. Material balance પરથી એકલું steam requirement ન મળે. Solute conservation પરથી concentrate અને પછી overall balance પરથી evaporated solvent શોધો. Multiple effects માટે overall solute balance લાગુ પડે છે, પણ દરેક effect ના vapour rates માટે વધુ data જોઈએ. Energy balance માટે feed/boiling temperatures, latent heats, losses તથા steam conditions જોઈએ.

q.en: State the definition/principle of Mixing—consistent concentration basis.
q.gu: Mixing—એકસરખી Concentration Basis ની વ્યાખ્યા/સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: Mixing combines streams to obtain a specified product composition. In a nonreacting mass-based blend, total mass and each component mass are conserved. The product concentration is a weighted average on the declared basis. Use kg with mass fractions or kmol with mole fractions. A volume percentage is not a mass percentage; densities and a suitable volume model are needed to switch between them. Two-stream target composition must lie between the feed compositions. If temperature changes, an additional energy balance may be needed; material balance does not imply isothermal mixing.
a.gu: Streams ભેગી કરીને specified composition મેળવવાની operation Mixing છે. Nonreacting mass-based blend માં total તથા દરેક component mass conserved છે. Product concentration declared basis પર weighted average છે. kg સાથે mass fractions અથવા kmol સાથે mole fractions લો. Volume percentage એ mass percentage નથી; conversion માટે densities તથા યોગ્ય volume model જોઈએ. Two-stream target બંને inlet compositions વચ્ચે હોવો જોઈએ. Temperature બદલાય તો energy balance પણ જોઈએ; material balance નો અર્થ isothermal mixing નથી.

q.en: State the definition/principle of Crystallization—solubility and hydrated crystals.
q.gu: Crystallization—Solubility તથા Hydrated Crystals ની વ્યાખ્યા/સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: Crystallization separates solid crystals from a solution by cooling, evaporation or both. Mother liquor is the remaining liquid solution. Solubility stated as kg solute per100 kg water must be converted to a solution mass fraction before use in a solution balance. For pure anhydrous crystals, the crystal solute fraction is1. For a hydrate, use the anhydrous-salt molecular mass divided by the hydrate molecular mass; the remainder is crystal water. Balance both salt and water, including evaporated water and any retained mother liquor if specified. Do not count water of crystallization as free mother-liquor water.
a.gu: Cooling, evaporation અથવા બંનેથી solution માંથી solid crystals અલગ કરવાની operation Crystallization છે. બાકી liquid solution Mother Liquor છે. Solubility kg solute per100 kg water માં હોય તો solution balance પહેલાં mass fraction માં convert કરો. Pure anhydrous crystals માટે crystal solute fraction 1 છે. Hydrate માટે anhydrous salt MW ને hydrate MW થી ભાગો; બાકી crystal water છે. Evaporated water અને specified retained liquor સહિત salt તથા water balance લો. Water of crystallization ને free mother-liquor water માં ન ગણો.
